{{Quote|That one looks hungry!''"<br />"''Nah, he's just smiling at you.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], dodging neebray in the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]]|<ref name="SoM" />}}
'''Neebray''' were flying, limbless creatures which varied greatly in size and habitat. They could be found on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], such as [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] [[Rishi moon|moon]], and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] (where they sometimes circled over [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]), and even in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], notably in the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] along the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]].<ref name="TCW:TVG" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Neebray_manta.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Giant neebray mantas in the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]]]]

On the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], tiny baby neebray flew among the coral forests of the moon's long-dried-up ocean beds as a stop along their [[Balmorra Run/Legends|interstellar voyage]].<ref name="DB" /> A moderately large variety had translucent wings, and could be found on a [[Rishi moon]]. The gigantic neebray manta lived in the vacuum of space, feeding on stellar gases. They used the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] as nesting grounds. They also used [[Veil Nebula/Legends|Veil Nebula]] as feeding ground,<ref name=":0">[[The Clone Wars 12|''The Clone Wars'' 12]]</ref> feeding on its stellar gases.<ref name="Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref>

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] encountered a flock of neebray mantas while navigating the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]] on their way through the Kaliida Nebula. A brush with one caused one of [[Matchstick/Legends|Matchstick's]] engine stabilizers to give out. This crippling would cause Matchstick and [[Tag (clone trooper pilot)/Legends|Tag's]] deaths during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]]. A brush with another neebray caused another pilot's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid's]] dome to be knocked off, destroying it.<ref name="DB" />

[[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]] and [[Tofen's Raiders/Legends|his raiders]] hid [[Harko Station|their base]] in the [[Veil Nebula/Legends|Veil Nebula]]. When the Republic attacked the base, Vane and his raiders used a transmission to make the neebray attack the Republic ships.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rishi_moon_neebray.png|thumb|right|180px|A neebray on Rishi moon]]
At least three separate neebray breeds were based on the neebray manta model, and do not necessarily all have to be neebray manta.<ref name="EpGuide" />

Similar creatures included the [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]] and [[Oswaft]].

[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] mispronounced the name as "NEH-bray man-ta" in "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]."
